title: SignalFabric: entrant chronicle & procurement alert engine
creator: Sofia Reyes
description:
Goal: deliver a lightweight, automatable system that continuously ingests signals about new model entrants (open and commercial), scores their compatibility with Redwood serving and enterprise constraints, and emits procurement-ready alerts and playbook links for GTM/procurement teams.

Scope:
- Ingest feeds: model release pages, GitHub tags, vendor press releases, quantization/weight artifacts, benchmark feeds (latency/cost), and partner-provided availability signals.
- Enrich with compatibility heuristics: hardware affinity, quantization support, licensing flags, size/class, known regressions, API compatibility.
- Real-time scoring: a configurable composite score (compatibility, latency risk, supply fragility, enterprise-readiness).
- Alerting: threshold-based pushes to Slack channels, procurement dashboard inbox, and a lightweight email digest for strategic accounts.
- Integrations: Console signal panel, procurement CRM tags, and a first-pass webhook for SRE/autoscaling impact forecasts.

Success metrics (first 8 weeks):
- 90% precision on high-priority alerts (teams signaled are relevant).
- Mean time to actionable-signal < 24h for high-severity entrants.
- Procurement ticket conversion: 30% of alerts create an internal procurement review within 2 business days.

Non-goals: full automated procurement decisions, deep model evals (deferred to separate evaluation pipelines), or replacing existing vendor-relations workflows.

Design trade-offs considered:
- Conservative scoring vs. recall: default to higher precision to avoid alert fatigue; provide an opt-in high-recall stream.
- Centralized ingestion service vs. per-region crawlers: begin centralized with region tags to speed MVP rollout.

Deliverables:
1) Ingest pipeline + schema (MVP)
2) Scoring policy with tunable weights and an admin UI
3) Alerting connectors (Slack + dashboard inbox + email digest)
4) Procurement playbook templates attached to alerts
5) Observability: alert accuracy dashboard and feedback loop for label correction
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline ingests at least 6 distinct signal sources and stores normalized artifacts
Scoring service returns a score and triage-reason string for each entrant within 10s
Configured alert workflows deliver to #procurement-alerts and the SignalFabric dashboard
Procurement playbook links surface in the alert card and are editable by PMs
Accuracy dashboard shows precision/recall for the high-confidence bucket and supports manual feedback
